CREATE TABLE  `dof_native`.`gift_code`  (   `id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'ID',   `task_id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '任务ID  对应gift_task表的task_id',   `code_id` int(15) NOT NULL COMMENT '道具代码',   `code_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '道具名称',   `code_num` int(10) NOT NULL COMMENT '道具数量',   `code_odds` int(10) NOT NULL COMMENT '道具进入奖池的几率  0-100    越大作为奖励道具的几率越高',   `code_state` int(10) NOT NULL COMMENT '道具状态  1=可用  0=不可用',   PRIMARY KEY USING BTREE (`id`) ) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = COMPACT;

CREATE TABLE `dof_native`.`ai`  (				`id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL,				`ai_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'AI假人的名称',				`ai_msg` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '喊话配置   0不喊话  1一直喊话   2随机时间喊话（填写10就是10%几率喊话）',				`ai_zhanjie` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '站街配置    0不站街  1一直站街   2随机时间站街（填写10就是10%几率站街5-20分钟  否则就是行走5-20分钟）',				`ai_state` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '状态   0停用  1生效',				`ai_yisu` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '移动速度配置  1随机  大于1则是固定移速的值',				`ai_sleep` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行走延迟  单位秒  每次移动坐标的延迟时间',				PRIMARY KEY USING BTREE(`id`)				) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = Compact;

CREATE TABLE `dof_native`.`ai_hh`  (				`id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL,				`hh_text` varchar(2000) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '喊话内容',				`hh_state` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '状态   0停用  1生效',				PRIMARY KEY USING BTREE(`id`)				) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = Compact;

CREATE TABLE `dof_native`.`ai_map`  (				`id` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NOT NULL,				`ditu_id` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '地图的ID',				`fangjian_id` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '房间的ID',				`x_min` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'x轴最小值',				`x_max` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'x轴最大值',				`y_min` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'y轴最小值',				`y_max` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'y轴最大值',				`ditu_name` varchar(255) CHARACTER SET utf8 COLLATE utf8_general_ci NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '地图的中文名称，方便查看',				`fangjian_max_time` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '房间最大停留时间  分钟',				`ditu_state` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '状态   0停用  1生效',				PRIMARY KEY USING BTREE(`id`)				) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = Compact;

CREATE TABLE `dof_native`.`ai_user`  (				`uid` int(11) NOT NULL COMMENT '账号的uid',				`msg_state` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '喊话开关 0关闭  1开启',				`move_state` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行走开关 0关闭  1开启',				PRIMARY KEY USING BTREE(`uid`)				) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = Compact;

CREATE TABLE `dof_native`.`ai_user_temp`  (				`id` int(11) NOT NULL COMMENT '假人socket连接id',				`uid` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '账号的uid',				`x` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '角色坐标X',				`y` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '角色坐标Y',				`ditu_id` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '地图的ID',				`fangjian_id` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '房间的ID',				`pingdao_id` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '频道ID',				`state` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '假人状态',				`login_time` int(11) NULL DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '在线时间',				PRIMARY KEY USING BTREE(`id`)				) ENGINE = InnoDB CHARACTER SET = utf8 COLLATE = utf8_general_ci ROW_FORMAT = Compact;
